notes: no man renders the clause negative lo recast onto the subject nominal under rule 15; ish keeps only man.
whether ... or answers to two written im particles, so each takes the word written for it rather than forming one correlative unit (rule 14).
la-YHWH is rendered inside the English genitive Jehovah's, so the preposition shares that word's unit and the construction's copula joins it (rule 49).
